caseNameFull: CAVANAUGH, EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR, SOUTH CAROLINA DEPARTMENT OF PROBATION, PAROLE, AND PARDON SERVICES v. ROLLER
attorneys: Carl N. Lundberg argued the cause for petitioners. With him on the briefs were T. Travis Medlock, Attorney General of South Carolina, and Edwin W. Evans, Chief Deputy Attorney General., W.
